SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = PODT.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, '재고' GUBUN, MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME) AS ADD_USER_NAME, MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL) AS ADD_USER_TEL, POHD.PO_NO, MAX(POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_DATE, MAX(PODT.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE, IVDT.INV_NO, MAX(PODT.DS_DATE) AS INV_DATE, MAX(IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE) AS GR_DATE, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX((SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_TEL FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE POHD.BUYER = #{ware_house_code} AND POHD.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND IVDT.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ GROUP BY POHD.BUYER, POHD.PO_NO,IVDT.INV_NO
SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE =EDI.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, 'VMI' GUBUN, MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = EDI.POK_USER_ID)) ADD_USER_NAME, MAX((SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = EDI.POK_USER_ID)) ADD_USER_TEL, VPO_NO AS PO_NO, MAX(VPO_DATE) AS PO_DATE, MAX(RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE, VPO_NO AS INV_NO, MAX(RD_DATE) AS INV_DATE, MAX(VGR_DATE) AS GR_DATE, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=EDI.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX((SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=EDI.AGENT)) AS AGENT_TEL
FROM EDIVPODT EDI WHERE BUYER = #{ware_house_code} AND VPO_NO =#{PO_NO} GROUP BY BUYER, VPO_NO

/*selectMasterWmGrStockWarehousingManagerPopVMIList*/ SELECT EDI.BUYER_ITEM_NO, EDI.CONTRACT_NO, EDI.CONTRACT_SEQ, EDI.DESCRIPTION, EDI.MAKER_NAME, EDI.ITEM_QTY, STCK.AVAIL_QTY, EDI.UNIT_PRICE, EDI.UNIT_MEASURE, EDI.SPECIFICATION, EDI.GR_QTY, STCK.PRE_GR_QTY, EDI.ITEM_AMT, EDI.VPO_SEQ INV_SEQ, EDI.VPO_SEQ, EDI.IV_QTY INV_QTY, 'Y' AS GR_MODIFIABLE FROM EDIVPODT EDI , WMSSTCK STCK WHERE BUYER =#{ware_house_code} AND VPO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND EDI.BUYER = STCK.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND EDI.BUYER_ITEM_NO = STCK.STDCATLG_ID AND EDI.STATUS <> 'D' AND EDI.AGENT = STCK.AGENT AND EDI.CONTRACT_NO = STCK.CONTRACT_NO AND EDI.CONTRACT_SEQ = STCK.CONTRACT_SEQ AND STCK.STATUS <> 'D'

/*selectMasterWmGrStockWarehousingManagerPopList*/ SELECT PO.BUYER_ITEM_NO, PO.CONTRACT_NO, PO.CONTRACT_SEQ, PO.DESCRIPTION, PO.MAKER_NAME, PO.ITEM_QTY, STCK.AVAIL_QTY, PO.UNIT_PRICE, PO.UNIT_MEASURE, PO.SPECIFICATION, IV.WMS_GR_QTY AS GR_QTY, STCK.PRE_GR_QTY, PO.ITEM_AMT, IV.INV_SEQ, PO.PO_SEQ VPO_SEQ, IV.INV_QTY INV_QTY, (CASE WHEN GR.AP_BILL_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'N' WHEN GR.GR_DATE IS NULL THEN 'N' WHEN PO.PROCESS_TYPE <> '1' THEN 'Y' WHEN SUBSTR(GR.GR_DATE, 1, 6) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') THEN 'Y' WHEN SUBSTR(GR.GR_DATE, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1), 'YYYYMM') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DD') <= '06' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS GR_MODIFIABLE FROM ICOMPODT PO, WMSSTCK STCK ,ICOMCQDT CQ,ICOMIVDT IV , WMSIVDT WMS, ICOMGRDT GR WHERE PO.BUYER = #{ware_house_code} AND PO.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND IV.INV_NO = #{st_inv_no} AND PO.BUYER = IV.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = IV.PO_NO AND PO.PO_SEQ = IV.PO_SEQ AND PO.BUYER = CQ.BUYER AND PO.CONTRACT_NO = CQ.CONTRACT_NO AND PO.CONTRACT_SEQ = CQ.CONTRACT_SEQ AND CQ.BUYER = STCK.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO = STCK.STDCATLG_ID AND CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO = STCK.STDCATLG_ID AND PO.BUYER = WMS.BUYER(+) AND PO.PO_NO = WMS.PO_NO(+) AND PO.PO_SEQ = WMS.PO_SEQ(+) AND IV.BUYER = GR.BUYER(+) AND IV.INV_NO = GR.INV_NO(+) AND IV.INV_SEQ = GR.INV_SEQ(+) AND PO.STATUS <> 'D' AND STCK.STATUS <> 'D' AND CQ.STATUS <> 'D' AND WMS.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND GR.STATUS(+) <> 'D'
mapper.update: UPDATE WMSSTCK SET TOT_QTY = TOT_QTY - (${GR_QTY}), AVAIL_QTY = AVAIL_QTY - (${GR_QTY}), PRE_GR_QTY = PRE_GR_QTY + ${GR_QTY}, STC_SELLER_PRICE = ${UNIT_PRICE} WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{ware_house_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = (SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM EDIVPODT WHERE BUYER = #{ware_house_code} AND VPO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND VPO_SEQ = #{VPO_SEQ}) AND AGENT = (SELECT AGENT FROM EDIVPODT WHERE BUYER =#{ware_house_code} AND VPO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND VPO_SEQ = #{VPO_SEQ}) AND CONTRACT_NO = (SELECT CONTRACT_NO FROM EDIVPODT WHERE BUYER = #{ware_house_code} AND VPO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND VPO_SEQ =#{VPO_SEQ}) AND CONTRACT_SEQ = (SELECT CONTRACT_SEQ FROM EDIVPODT WHERE BUYER = #{ware_house_code} AND VPO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND VPO_SEQ = #{VPO_SEQ})
